resources.string: Accessibility service: off (tap to enable, required for remote control)

First run: enable "TV Remote Service" in system Settings → Accessibility. No root required.\nThen choose "Direct" or "BT" in the phone app and enter the 6-digit pairing code above.\nThe service starts automatically on every boot (including after power loss).
Receives remote commands from the phone and performs back, home, D-pad, volume and text input actions.
